_about: The forest level-up cards. One list for both the Blender card art (make_cards.py) and the Unity game (Resources/Cards/cards.json). hero = the class a Mythic card belongs to (empty = any class). art = what the card picture shows.

cards.name: Bullfrog Chorus
cards.text: At full Croak your punches send out a booming shockwave that hits everything around you.

cards.name: Lilypad Rebound
cards.text: Your Tongue Uppercut counter hits twice and gives back your dodge at once.

cards.name: Monsoon Fists
cards.text: Croak never fades. Every Croak point makes you attack 10% faster.

cards.name: Riverheart Torrent
cards.text: After a perfect dodge your spells cost no Mana for 4 seconds.

cards.name: Clutch of Storms
cards.text: Your Tidal Orb leaves three storm eggs that hatch into homing water bolts.

cards.name: Duckbill Sonar
cards.text: You sense attacks early: red warnings last 25% longer and your perfect dodge window grows by 40%.

cards.name: Shell of the Old Oak
cards.text: Your Shell Riposte counter also gives a shield worth 30% of your max HP.

cards.name: Sanctified Roll
cards.text: Your dodge becomes a holy roll that hurts every enemy you roll through.

cards.name: Dawnplate Judgement
cards.text: At full Faith your next attack calls down a pillar of light on everything near you.

cards.name: Ninefold Foxfire
cards.text: Your Foxfire Volley counter fires nine burning arrows in a fan.

cards.name: Hunter's Mark
cards.text: Your arrows mark enemies. Marked enemies take 35% more damage and burst into foxfire when they fall.

cards.name: Fox Spirit Twin
cards.text: A ghost fox runs beside you and copies every arrow you shoot at half damage.

cards.name: Regrowing Tail
cards.text: Every perfect dodge drops a decoy tail that pulls enemies in, then explodes.

cards.name: Venom Kiss
cards.text: Your stabs poison. Poison stacks up to 5 times and Envenom bursts all of it at once.

cards.name: Wallcrawler Ambush
cards.text: After a perfect dodge your next 3 attacks are sure critical hits for double damage.

cards.name: Skybreaker Iaido
cards.text: Your Talon Iaido counter cuts a long line through every enemy in it, for double damage.

cards.name: Feathered Gale
cards.text: Every dodge leaves a spray of razor feathers that cut enemies near you.

cards.name: Eye of the Storm
cards.text: At full Gale, the world slows to half speed for 3 seconds while you stay fast.

cards.name: Heart of the Oak
cards.text: +25% max HP and heal to full.

cards.name: Thornbark Mail
cards.text: Enemies that hit you take 30% of the damage back.

cards.name: Fairy Ring
cards.text: Your perfect dodge window is 50% wider.

cards.name: Firefly Lantern
cards.text: Your counterattack is ready 35% sooner.

cards.name: Moonpetal Bloom
cards.text: Each counterattack heals you for 8% of your max HP.

cards.name: Acorn of Plenty
cards.text: +40% experience from every enemy.

cards.name: Stag's Crown
cards.text: +20% damage on everything you do.

cards.name: Wind Through Leaves
cards.text: +15% move speed and your dodge goes 25% farther.

cards.name: Honeycomb Hoard
cards.text: Fallen enemies sometimes drop honey that heals 6 HP.

cards.name: Spore Burst
cards.text: Enemies burst into spores when they fall, hurting enemies around them.

cards.name: Owl's Vigil
cards.text: +15% chance for any hit to be critical (double damage).

cards.name: Root Snare
cards.text: Your counterattack roots the attacker in place for 1.5 seconds.
